unsupported: BG Southern Nevada, headquartered in North Las Vegas, Nevada, operates as a distributor for BG Products, Inc., a company founded in 1971 in Wichita, Kansas, by seven World War II veterans—John Thompson, Sam Parks, Don Walton, O.J. Connell, Q.T. Williams, Don Broadbent—and land-speed record holder Roy Leslie.
BG Southern Nevada also provides training programs for service advisors and technicians, including BG Certified Service Advisor Training and BG University, founded in 1999.
The company serves the automotive aftermarket, including new-car dealerships, independent repair shops, franchise service centers, and fleet operators.
